{{Locations|Slug Controlled Nebula|Slug Home Nebula|alsooccur=exitandfiller|LRSmap=noship|unique=false}} 


The intro text for this event varies, and could be any of the following:
*''You arrive at a beacon located in a civilian star system. A nearby colony contacts you: "We've got a rogue Rebel ship harassing this system. Do you have time to find it?"''
*''As soon as you arrive, you receive a Federation encrypted message: "A Rebel ship has been terrorizing the local civilians in this system, please seek and destroy it."''
*''You begin charging your FTL drive, and do a quick scan of a local planet. You find the ruins of a recently destroyed federation colony on the surface. There must be a Rebel ship in the vicinity...''
*''You jump into a field of debris. It appears a battle recently took place here, and the loser seems to have been a civilian ship. A message was left on repeat before it was destroyed: "Rebels attacking, please send aid!" The responsible Rebels are likely still nearby.''
*#Go looking for the Rebel ship.
*#*{{DuplicateEvent|2}} ''After a short search you find the Rebel ship. Let's hope he's as easy to defeat in combat as he was to find.'' &nbsp;'''OR''' &nbsp;''You are able to quickly track down the Rebel. Let's hope he's as easy to defeat in combat as he was to find.''
*#**Fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).
*#*''After far too much time spent searching, you are finally able to track him down. You go into the fight pondering just how much of a head start you've lost on the Rebel Fleet...''
*#**Rebel Fleet <span style="color:red">pursuit</span> is <span style="color:red">doubled</span> for <span style="color:red">1 jump</span>, and you fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).
*#*''You spend some time looking but your scanners cannot pick up any trace of the Rebel ship. You prepare to move on.''
*#**Nothing happens.
*#No time to search, you prepare to jump away.
*#*Nothing happens.
*#{{Blue Option|Improved Sensors|Perform a scan of the area.|level=2|shortreq=Sensors}}
*#*''You quickly find the rebel ship's location and move to intercept.''
*#**Fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).
*#{{Blue Option|Advanced Sensors|Pinpoint the Rebel's location.|level=3|shortreq=Sensors}}
*#*''You find the Rebel ship hiding on a nearby asteroid. You are able to get a shot off and permanently disable their engines before they notice you.''
*#**Fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]), which <span style="color: lawngreen>engines are disabled</span>.
